scripts.name: Import image to active view
scripts.summary: Copies a raster image beside the active RVT when requested, then imports, centers, and proportionally scales it in the visible view.

selection.description: No selection is required; the image is placed in the active view.

inputs.name: width_fraction
inputs.description: Target image width as a fraction of the visible view width, from 0.01 to 1.0.

inputs.name: copy_to_document_folder
inputs.description: Copy the image beside the saved active Revit document before import.

output.description: Imported image IDs, view name, persistent source path, copy status, and final dimensions in feet.

scripts.name: Create Toposolid from model lines
scripts.summary: Samples selected model curves and creates a point-based Toposolid from their XYZ elevations.

selection.description: Three or more non-collinear XYZ points sampled from selected ModelCurve elements.

inputs.name: sampling_step_mm
inputs.description: Approximate sampling interval along each selected curve, in millimetres.

inputs.name: xy_tolerance_mm
inputs.description: XY tolerance used to merge duplicate sampled points, in millimetres.

inputs.name: toposolid_type_name
inputs.description: Exact Toposolid type name. The first type alphabetically is used when omitted.

inputs.name: level_name
inputs.description: Exact level name. The active view level or nearest level is used when omitted.

output.description: Created element ID and a summary of the sampled geometry, type, level, and Z range.

scripts.name: Create model-line contour from linked STL slice
scripts.summary: Polygonizes a selected linked STL slice, heals small gaps between mesh fragments, and creates the largest exterior shell as model lines.

selection.description: Exactly one linked ImportInstance containing the STL mesh geometry.

inputs.name: level_name
inputs.description: Exact Revit level name used as the base elevation.

inputs.name: slice_offset_mm
inputs.description: Horizontal slice offset above the level, in millimetres.

inputs.name: endpoint_snap_mm
inputs.description: XY grid used to snap section-segment endpoints, in millimetres.

inputs.name: gap_healing_mm
inputs.description: Buffer distance used to close gaps between polygonized STL fragments, in millimetres; zero disables healing.

inputs.name: simplification_tolerance_mm
inputs.description: Topology-preserving contour simplification tolerance, in millimetres.

inputs.name: minimum_contour_area_m2
inputs.description: Minimum accepted contour area, in square metres.

inputs.name: assembly_paths
inputs.description: Semicolon-separated full paths to NetTopologySuite prerequisite DLLs and NetTopologySuite.dll, in load order; omit when already loaded.

inputs.name: line_style_name
inputs.description: Model-line subcategory name used for the created contour.

output.description: Source, slice, geometry-processing, contour-area, model-line, sketch-plane, and line-style details.

scripts.name: Calculate selected lines length in millimetres
scripts.summary: Calculates the total length of selected curve elements and prints millimetres.

selection.description: One or more CurveElement instances. Non-curve elements are ignored.

output.description: Total selected curve length in millimetres.

scripts.name: Calculate element volume
scripts.summary: Calculates solid volumes for selected family instances and prints cubic metres.

selection.description: One or more FamilyInstance elements with valid solid geometry.

output.description: A list containing cubic-metre volumes or per-element error messages.

scripts.name: Delete BIMO preview rays
scripts.summary: Deletes DirectShape elements whose ApplicationId is BIMO_PreviewRays.

selection.description: No selection is required; all matching DirectShape elements in the active document are deleted.

output.description: Number of deleted DirectShape elements, or a message when no match exists.
